title: HB1173 (2023 Regular): prevent the enforcement of federal laws and directives related to firearms, accessories, and ammunition.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (South Dakota) (gun-policy Stage 5, South Dakota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official South Dakota text (Introduced, 2023-01-26; official copy, https://mylrc.sdlegislature.gov/api/Documents/246806.pdf (sdlegislature.gov DocumentId 246806, BillId 23727))
provenance.note: Introduced text, 2023-01-26; no passage vote on record.

operative_text:
Section 1 (new section in SDCL title 23): No state agency, political subdivision, or any elected or appointed official or employee of this state or of a political subdivision may contract with or provide assistance to a federal agency or official with respect to the enforcement of a federal statute, regulation, or executive order, which imposes a prohibition, restriction, or requirement that does not exist under the laws of this state, and relates to the sale, transfer, ownership, or possession of: (1) A firearm, or any component or accessory; or (2) Ammunition, or any component or accessory.
Section 2 (new section in SDCL title 23): Any elected or appointed official or employee of this state or of a political subdivision who knowingly violates section 1 of this Act is subject to: (1) A civil penalty in the amount of $1000 for a first violation; and (2) A Class 1 misdemeanor for a second or subsequent violation.
Section 3 (new section in SDCL title 23): This Act does not apply to any contract requiring the provision of assistance in the enforcement of a federal statute, regulation, or executive order, if the contract was entered into before July 1, 2023.
